about_short_description.short_description: The Forecasting Company is a Software Development firm offering foundation models for forecasting.

product.name: t_0
product.description: A forecasting model designed to generate precise predictions across any time series data for various time horizons.

product.name: Retrocast
product.description: A browser-based forecasting platform that enables users to upload time series data, generate forecasts using t_0, and compare predictions with actual data.

product.name: Forecasting API
product.description: An API service that provides programmatic access to the t_0 model and other open source forecasting models for integration into business workflows.
